final_answer: IT IS NOT POSSIBLE TO TILE AN 8X8 CHESSBOARD WITH 2X1 DOMINOES IF TWO OPPOSITE CORNERS ARE REMOVED. THE REASON LIES IN THE COLORING OF THE CHESSBOARD. EACH DOMINO COVERS ONE BLACK AND ONE WHITE SQUARE. HOWEVER, REMOVING TWO OPPOSITE CORNERS (WHICH ARE ALWAYS OF THE SAME COLOR) LEAVES AN UNEQUAL NUMBER OF BLACK AND WHITE SQUARES (30 OF ONE COLOR AND 32 OF THE OTHER). SINCE EACH DOMINO MUST COVER ONE SQUARE OF EACH COLOR, THE DISCREPANCY MAKES TILING IMPOSSIBLE.
